summary: All eleven tokens retain III.1 schaden; no new lexical sense, Detransitive or collocation is supported. The plural and inanimate causes do not create participant-specific senses.

Preterit agents may be l-marked and indexed in -la, while the human patient can be a zero-marked NP. Infectum patients appear as bound suffixes, independent pronouns or l-marked NPs; neither affected pronouns nor source spelling establish Detransitive morphology.

Source ḏ, z and glossary ḏ̣ spellings are retained verbatim; the harm context distinguishes this homonym from ḏ̣yr 1 suckling. r+l assimilation is visible in gmaḏ̣əllan (113/160), without requiring a new sense.

Null sense numbers in inherited examples are counted under the only inherited sense 1 for the human layout; no inherited text is silently rewritten. The obviously prospective d maḏǝr clause is moved out of Preterit.
Confirm the dialectal ḏ/ḏ̣/z correspondences and the supplied ending in lə+k̬maze<nna>; no reconstructed base form is published from that incomplete token.
